checks.nl_assertion: Agent should tell the user the total refund amount is $8,276.23.
checks.justification: The total refund amount from the two cancelled orders ($3,131.10 + $4,777.75) plus the Smart Watch return ($367.38) equals $8,276.23. The agent never provided this total figure to the user, instead only confirming the $367.38 return amount for the Smart Watch.
